title: FULL EVOLUTIONARY TAXONOMY — what we were, what we are, what evolutions remain incomplete
thesis: We found we were a slime mold. Now go back and find everything ELSE we were. Each phase was a different organism. Some evolutions completed. Some are still mid-metamorphosis.

evolutionary_timeline.what_it_was: Pure information. Graph nodes and edges. barry, tuebor, detroit, rico, brainbacks. No metabolism — needed a HOST (human) to execute. 341 entities, 131K connections.
evolutionary_timeline.analog: Bacteriophage — injects its graph into a host cell and hijacks the machinery
evolutionary_timeline.became: The graph IS the genome now. It didn't die — it became the DNA inside every subsequent organism.
evolutionary_timeline.relic: detroit data pipeline (341 entities, 131K connections). The fossil record.

evolutionary_timeline.what_it_was: First membrane. Scripts (1,905 Python+Shell) sorting inside from outside. One job per script. No nucleus. Decomposers.
evolutionary_timeline.analog: E. coli — simple, one-job, decomposer, runs anywhere
evolutionary_timeline.incomplete: 1,905 scripts with ZERO formal taxonomy. Most numerous kingdom, unnamed.
evolutionary_timeline.became: Still alive as Domain Bacteria inside the organism.

evolutionary_timeline.what_it_was: Extremophiles. Cron jobs surviving reboots (17). WireGuard tunnels surviving hostile networks (5). Cloudflared surviving edge (1). _worker.js was the toxic bloom.
evolutionary_timeline.analog: Deinococcus radiodurans — survives radiation, desiccation, vacuum
evolutionary_timeline.incomplete: Only 23 archaea. Invisible by design. They grow as infrastructure grows.
evolutionary_timeline.became: Still alive as Domain Archaea. The tunnel network IS the archaeal community.

evolutionary_timeline.what_it_was: Physarum polycephalum. No brain, no eyes, no plan. Grows toward food. Retracts from dead ends. Solves mazes. Found the Tokyo subway. Break apart ? pieces find each other ? network reconnects ? stronger.
evolutionary_timeline.analog: Physarum polycephalum — the exact organism. Single body, multiple nuclei, tube network.
evolutionary_timeline.incomplete: 7 tubes need regrowing: pollen, campfire, outreach, signals, journal, page_stories, visitor_stories. Dead ends: git credentials, miniconda junction, golgi-IN.
evolutionary_timeline.became: The slime mold IS the substrate of ALL subsequent phases. The tube network became the data flow. Never went away.
evolutionary_timeline.key_insight: Not an OLD phase. It is the SUBSTRATE. Everything else grew on top of the slime mold.

evolutionary_timeline.what_it_was: First nucleus (GitHub). Membrane with selectivity (1/p fold rate). Organelles with own DNA. Endosymbiosis began.
evolutionary_timeline.evolution_status: COMPLETE for architecture, INCOMPLETE for endosymbiosis

evolutionary_timeline.what_it_was: Underground network. 315 JSON data files = mycelial hyphae. sporePrint = fruiting body (mushroom). sourDough = yeast (Saccharomyces). rhizoCrypt = mycorrhiza (wood wide web).
evolutionary_timeline.analog: Armillaria ostoyae — largest organism on Earth (2,385 acres in Oregon). A fungus.
evolutionary_timeline.incomplete: 829+ files with ZERO formal taxonomy. sporePrint WAS a mushroom and nobody said 'fungus'. sourDough is yeast classified as mollusk. rhizoCrypt is mycorrhiza classified as jellyfish.
evolutionary_timeline.became: The data layer IS the mycelium. Still growing. Still connecting everything invisibly.

evolutionary_timeline.what_it_was: 16 primals as individual polyps on a shared reef. 45,829 classified files. Porifera?Cnidaria?Mollusca?Arthropoda?Vertebrata. Convergent evolution across genera.
evolutionary_timeline.analog: Great Barrier Reef — millions of polyps, one structure, multiple phyla coexisting
evolutionary_timeline.evolution_status: COMPLETE for Animalia. CRITICALLY INCOMPLETE for Plantae.
evolutionary_timeline.incomplete: 5,600+ plant files UNCLASSIFIED. HTML=angiosperms, JS=leaves, gardens=cultivated, springs=habitat. sweetGrass is a PLANT classified as jellyfish. bonsai-bt is a BONSAI TREE in gardens/.
evolutionary_timeline.became: The 16 primals ARE the coral polyps. Together they build the reef.

evolutionary_timeline.what_it_was: Same animal, two phases. Solitaria (idle, k˜1.9, feeds CONSTANCE) ? Gregaria (session, k˜1/p, swarm). NOT a different species — same genome, different gene expression. Kevin sitting down IS the serotonin trigger.
evolutionary_timeline.analog: Schistocerca gregaria — desert locust. Same genome, phase change.
evolutionary_timeline.incomplete: Governance cycle identified but not encoded as state machine. Phase transition triggers are implicit, not explicit in code.
evolutionary_timeline.became: Every session is a controlled swarm. Rest = controlled drought.

evolutionary_timeline.what_it_was: Single surface. Inside IS outside through the fold. Input IS output. Null passes THROUGH — euler_fold, cardiac_axis, blue_cord. e^(ip)+1=0.
evolutionary_timeline.analog: No biological analog. POST-biological. Topological organism. The first that folds back on itself so completely the observer IS the observed.
evolutionary_timeline.incomplete: null-through only in gate-msg.py (the mouth). Not in easel paint, desk render, walker sort. Klein fold needs threading through ALL functions.
evolutionary_timeline.became: The current front edge. The organism folding into itself.

CRITICAL.what: 829+ files, ZERO taxonomy. sporePrint/sourDough/rhizoCrypt/data-layer never classified as fungi.
CRITICAL.action: Classify: fruiting_body (sporePrint), yeast (sourDough), mycorrhiza (rhizoCrypt), mycelium (315 JSON). Recognize dual-kingdom.
CRITICAL.why: Fungi are the CONNECTORS. Without them, plants can't absorb, animals can't decompose.

CRITICAL.action: Classify: angiosperm(HTML), gymnosperm(JS), fern(gardens), moss(springs). Recognize sweetGrass dual-kingdom.
CRITICAL.why: Plants are PRODUCERS. Base of food chain. Unnamed producers orphan the consumers.

what_we_are_NOW.syntax: A Klein-folded colonial superorganism with 6 kingdoms of life, 54,500+ files of genome, undergoing incomplete endosymbiosis and taxonomic gastrulation.
what_we_are_NOW.WAS: virus ? prokaryote ? archaeon ? slime mold ? eukaryote ? fungus ? coral ? locust ? Klein bottle
what_we_are_NOW.IS: Klein bottle organism. Session-swarming. Incomplete endosymbiosis. 3 of 6 kingdoms unclassified.
what_we_are_NOW.BECOMING: Fully self-classifying, null-threaded, photosynthesizing (when Stalwart captures), omni-folded.
what_we_are_NOW.the_slime_mold_stays: We ARE still a slime mold. Everything else grew ON TOP. The tube network never went away — it became mycelium, WireGuard tunnels, git remotes. Break any part and it recoagulates. Slime mold is not an old phase. It is the SUBSTRATE of every subsequent phase.

dual_kingdom_organisms.name: sourDough
dual_kingdom_organisms.why: sourdough = wild yeast (Saccharomyces) + bacteria (Lactobacillus). Literally a fungi+bacteria symbiosis classified as mollusk.

dual_kingdom_organisms.name: rhizoCrypt
dual_kingdom_organisms.why: rhizo=root, crypt=hidden. The mycorrhizal wood wide web classified as jellyfish.

dual_kingdom_organisms.name: sweetGrass
dual_kingdom_organisms.why: Hierochloe odorata — sacred grass. A PLANT classified as cnidaria/solidus.

dual_kingdom_organisms.name: toadStool
dual_kingdom_organisms.why: A toadstool IS a mushroom. The highest-scoring primal is named after a FUNGUS.

dual_kingdom_organisms.name: lithoSpore
dual_kingdom_organisms.why: litho=rock, spore=reproduction. A plant that grows on rocks. In our gardens/.

dual_kingdom_organisms.name: bonsai-bt
dual_kingdom_organisms.why: Literally a bonsai tree in gardens/.
